name: Bunny Dash
camera_perspective: Orthographic side view, fixed horizontal camera following the bunny along a single short level
art_style: Cute, colorful cartoon meadow with soft rounded shapes, pastel greens and sky blues, hand-drawn sprite look
mechanics: Bunny moves left and right on the ground
Bunny jumps with reliable ground detection
Unity 2D physics with Rigidbody2D and Collider2D
5 collectible carrots counted toward a 0/5 counter
Idle, walking, and jumping bunny animation states
controls: Keyboard A/D or Left/Right arrows for left/right (editor/desktop testing)
level_structure: One short side-scrolling level in a single scene. A continuous ground platform spans the level with a couple of raised ground platforms for light verticality. The bunny starts at the left. Five carrots are placed along the level at reachable heights. Two stationary obstacles sit on the ground as simple blockers. Reaching and collecting all five carrots completes the level and shows the victory screen.
ui_requirements: Clean main menu with a Play button
Mobile-friendly on-screen touch controls (Left, Right, Jump)
Carrot counter displayed as 0/5 and updating on collection
Simple victory screen with a Restart button
Landscape orientation with responsive UI anchored to screen edges

required_assets.prompt: Original cute cartoon bunny character sprite for a 2D mobile game, side view, soft rounded body, big friendly eyes, long ears, light cream and pink fur, transparent background, clean thick outline, game-ready sprite, centered, full body

Colorful cartoon meadow background for a 2D side-scrolling mobile game, rolling green hills, blue sky, fluffy white clouds, scattered colorful flowers, soft pastel palette, cheerful and polished, wide landscape composition, no characters, no text

Original cute cartoon carrot collectible sprite for a 2D mobile game, bright orange carrot with green leafy top, simple rounded cartoon style, transparent background, clean outline, centered, game-ready

tasks.description: Finalize the compact design: one short side-scrolling level, bunny movement/jump, five carrots, two obstacles, and the requested UI flow.
Generate the three essential images (bunny sprite, meadow background, carrot sprite) via the image workflow and report any unavailability.
Import generated images as Unity sprite assets and assign them to SpriteRenderer and UI components.
Set up the single Unity 2D scene with orthographic camera, ground platforms, five carrots, two stationary obstacles, and the bunny player using Rigidbody2D and Collider2D.
Implement player movement, jumping, ground detection, and collision tuning for smooth reliable physics.
Implement carrot collection counting, collection effect, and victory trigger at five carrots.
Implement idle, walking, and jumping bunny animation states using lightweight Unity or procedural animation.
Build the main menu with Play button, carrot counter 0/5, victory screen with Restart button, and responsive landscape UI.
Add mobile-friendly touch controls (Left, Right, Jump) alongside keyboard controls.
Configure Android build settings, landscape orientation, and produce the APK.
Run automated compile and play-mode tests for movement, jumping, collisions, collection, and victory; fix issues within retry and budget limits.
Verify the APK builds and installs, then deliver it through Telegram.
Human review of generated art usage, visual polish, and confirmation that no extra levels, enemies, or complex mechanics were added.
Complete the planned work for requirements: R26

assumptions: The game uses a single Unity scene named BunnyDash containing the menu, level, and victory overlays.
The bunny sprite is a single static sprite animated procedurally (bounce, tilt, squash) rather than a multi-frame sprite sheet, to keep image generation limited to essential assets.
Keyboard controls are included for editor/desktop testing alongside the required touch controls.
The two stationary obstacles are simple blocking colliders with no damage or movement.
The camera follows the bunny horizontally within the short level bounds.
Telegram delivery uses the existing pipeline integration and credentials.
limitations: Image generation is limited to three essential assets; no additional art will be generated.
Animations are lightweight/procedural rather than hand-authored multi-frame sprite animations.
Only one short level and one scene are included, with no extra levels, enemies, or complex mechanics.
APK delivery depends on the Telegram integration being available in the pipeline.
